Housing.description: Rent/Mortgage and base property costs. Strictly protected from budget cuts.

Utilities.description: Electricity, gas, water, internet. Inelastic basic necessities.

Healthcare.description: Medical, dental, pharmacy prescriptions. Protected health spending.

Groceries.description: Essential food supplies. Can be trimmed slightly if necessary.

Shopping.description: Apparel, electronics, personal goods. Highly flexible.

Dining.description: Restaurants, takeout, cafes, bars. Prime candidate for deficit trimming.

Entertainment.description: Movies, concerts, streaming services, hobbies. Highest reallocation flexibility.
